newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Renault to take control of Argentina's Ciadea.
newsitem.headline: Renault to take control of Argentina's Ciadea.

text.p: Argentine carmaker CIADEA SA said its French licensor Renault SA signed an agreement Friday to take control of COFAL, the holding company for Ciadea.
"In that role (Renault SA) will take indirect control of Ciadea," Ciadea's Director Javier Goni told the Buenos Aires Stock Exchange in a letter.
COFAL will keep its current 51 percent stake in Ciadea while Manuel Antelo will keep his post as Ciadea's President and Director General, Goni said.
He added Renault will incorporate into COFAL the 60 percent stake it has in its Brazilian unit Renault do Brasil Automoveis SA, tentatively within the nex 60 days.
The remaining 40 percent is in the hand of an investment company owned by Brazil's Parana state.
